rules.title: Board may make an exception
quotes: Any items critical to the function of the program may be considered as an exception to this rule at the board's discretion.

quotes: Gifts and gift cards

quotes: Durable goods (Items that are not for one-time use such as electronics, uniforms, etc.)

rules.title: Raw food needing refrigeration or preparation
quotes: Raw food items requiring refrigeration and/or preparation

rules.title: Restaurant dinners
quotes: Restaurant diners

rules.title: Rideshare and vehicle costs
quotes: Rideshare costs (Uber, Lyft, Buses, Vans, Amtrak cabins, Car rentals, etc.)

quotes: Any refundable deposits and fees pertaining to cleaning/damage

quotes: Payments to talent or performers

quotes: Monthly Subscriptions/Payments

quotes: International travel

quotes: Jewelry

rules.title: What counts as a durable good
quotes: A durable good is a product that is designed to last for an extended period, typically three years or more.
rules.source: USG Funding FAQ doc, Social Recreation Fund Q1

rules.title: No ticket sales
quotes: Events that include ticket sales

rules.title: On-campus events must be open to all students
quotes: On-campus events that are not open to all students

rules.title: No events in private residences
quotes: Events occurring in private residences

rules.title: $4,000 venue and personnel cap
quotes: The USG Funding Department will provide funding for up to $4,000 of the total cost associated with on-campus venue rentals and personnel.

rules.title: Over $4,000 is reviewed case by case
quotes: Events with expenses over $4,000 will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis to ensure effective use of funding.

rules.title: Multi-day events are reviewed case by case
quotes: Multi-day events will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

rules.title: $8,000 per organization per year
quotes: Individual organizations may receive a maximum of $8,000 from the USG Funding Department per year.
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §3; FAQ doc Q4

rules.title: Up to 4 funded events per semester
quotes: Each RSO can have up to 4 events funded per semester as long as it remains under $8,000 from the USG Funding Department per year.
rules.note: Not in the Guidelines; from the USG funding page FAQ and the application slides.

rules.title: Food at most $35 per person
quotes: Food requests should not exceed a $35 per person maximum based on expected attendance, and raw food items requiring refrigeration or preparation are not eligible.

rules.title: Food vendor health permit and insurance
quotes: RSOs must provide a Health Permit and Certificate of Insurance from the Food Vendor.

rules.title: Food justification
quotes: Additional information detailing why food is necessary and how it aligns with the event's purpose is required for review and approval.

rules.title: Hospitality food and beverage form
quotes: If serving food at event, please request and attach the food and beverage form from Hospitality

rules.title: ESR for on-campus events
quotes: ESRs for on campus events

rules.title: UEPA number
quotes: A UEPA is required anytime university funds are being used, food is part of an event, and/or any event with 25 or more people. Applications for conferences and travel for Academic Professional fund may not require a UEPA.
It starts with an A and has 5 or 6 digits.
rules.source: USG RSO Funding Application 2026-27 (draft), Event Details

rules.title: A quote for every expense
quotes: The full budget proposal for the event, including quotes for each individual expense
For online purchases, include a screenshot of the cart showing prices, quantities, and total price including all fees.
For Amazon purchases, create an Amazon Wish List and provide the link in the budget proposal.
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §2; FAQ doc Q11

rules.title: USG Vendor List
quotes: The Vendor List serves as a guide of previous vendors the University worked with. … the list is not exhaustive. We will not accept a vendor not on the list.

rules.title: T-shirts need a USC Trademarks-authorized vendor
quotes: T-Shirts funded by USG may only be produced by a vendor who is authorized to work with USC Trademarks.
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §4, Social and Recreation/Startup Fund

rules.title: Performing Arts: rentals and PO vendors only
quotes: Expenses related to production, staging, lighting, decoration (rentals only), venue, staffing, and security can only be funded if they are obtained from a PO Vendor.
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §4, Performing and Visual Arts

rules.title: Lodging at most $400 per night, with price comparison
quotes: Rooms cannot exceed $400 per night.
Proof of price comparison with other hotels is required for hotel expenses.

rules.title: Travel documents
quotes: Including name, DOB, phone number, USC email, USC ID #, and class level of all travelers
a clear statement of purpose that outlines the reasoning for the travel

rules.title: Applications open Wednesdays only
quotes: Funding applications will be open once a week on Wednesdays and close at 11:59 PM.
every Wednesday at 8:00 AM and close at 11:59 PM.
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §1; FAQ doc Q5

rules.title: Blackout dates
quotes: Applications for events between December 5, 2026 and January 12, 2027, as well as events after May 1, 2027, will not be considered or approved.
USG Funding does not process applications or provide funding for events during University holidays, breaks, study days, or finals.
rules.source: USG RSO Funding Application 2026-27 (draft), Application Timelines; USG Funding Department Guidelines §1

rules.title: Submission deadline (estimate)
quotes: at least six academic weeks six academic weeks before the initial payment due date, for approved USC Vendors
at least 9 academic weeks prior to the date of initial payment due date

alsoSee.quote: at least six academic weeks six academic weeks before the initial payment due date, for approved USC Vendors
six academic weeks before the event date when using an approved vendor, and or nine academic weeks before the initial payment due date (whichever comes first) for approved USC Vendors
six academic weeks before the event date when using an approved vendor, and eight academic weeks before the event date for new vendors and travel

alsoSee.source: USG RSO Funding Application 2026-27 (draft), intro text
alsoSee.quote: at least six weeks prior to the event date for USC approved vendors and nine weeks prior to the travel date

alsoSee.source: USG RSO Funding Application 2026-27 (draft), signed checkbox
alsoSee.quote: 8 weeks prior to the travel date

rules.title: Late applications are automatically denied
quotes: If this deadline is not met the application will be automatically denied.

rules.title: 2 business days to fix an incomplete application
quotes: Incomplete applications will be returned to the applicant who must provide the necessary information within 2 business days
2 business days is equivalent to 48 hours from the notification of an incomplete application
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §2; application slides

rules.title: After the event: evaluation and final invoices
quotes: All applicants must submit the Post Event Evaluation form … within three business days of the final day of the event.
This Post Event Evaluation form must include pictures of the event with members in attendance.
Final invoices must be submitted no later than three business days after the final day of the event.

rules.title: Performing, Visual Arts, & Cultural Fund
quotes: The Performing and Visual Arts Fund shall provide funding for events geared towards the arts programmed by recognized student organizations to celebrate, highlight, or foster a sense of community.

rules.title: Philanthropy Fund
quotes: The Philanthropy Fund shall provide funding for community service projects sponsored by recognized student organizations.

rules.title: Professional Academic Research Fund
quotes: …events programmed by recognized student organizations that help educate and advance students' future professional careers and academic research projects…

rules.title: Social, Recreational, and Startup Fund
quotes: …events programmed by recognized student organizations to celebrate, highlight, or foster a sense of community for the student group…

rules.title: Startup fund eligibility
quotes: student organizations first registered with the Office of Campus Activities within the last two academic semesters (fall or spring)

rules.title: Professional fund events must be free and open
quotes: must be free and open to all students

rules.title: USG Funding Department modules completed
quotes: make sure to complete the USG Funding Department modules during RSO Recognition
rules.source: USG Funding Department Guidelines §2; FAQ doc Q2

rules.title: Other University funding
quotes: RSO receiving funding from another University income source
